purpose: Closed-loop search intelligence: target queries -> live search observation -> competitor comparison -> real provider truth -> diagnosis -> smallest bounded repair candidate -> existing approval and publishing rules -> repair preparation -> same-query retest -> before/after evidence -> authority feedback.

hard_rules.R1_ZERO_COST_OBSERVATION_LANE: A live-search observation lane must exist and must be able to operate at zero incremental cost whenever the configured provider allowance permits. The observer may never exceed the declared free allowance; it records SKIPPED_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED instead of spending.
hard_rules.R2_NO_RANK_CONFLATION: Gemini or any other grounded/generative search observation must NEVER be represented as literal Google SERP rank. Grounded observations carry observation_kind=grounded_search_observation and is_literal_serp_rank=false, and may not carry rank or position fields.
hard_rules.R3_GSC_IS_OWN_SITE_AUTHORITY: Google Search Console is the only authority for actual own-site Google performance (impressions, clicks, CTR, average position, indexation). No other source may assert own-site Google performance.
hard_rules.R4_NO_SILENT_GREEN: Provider unavailable or degraded state must never silently produce green/OK. Every artifact carries provider_state and overall_status, and overall_status may not be a healthy value while any required provider is UNAVAILABLE or DEGRADED.
hard_rules.R5_NO_CADENCE_CHANGE: Search intelligence must never change the repo's existing publishing cadence. The search lane is read-and-prepare only. It may not write publishing, queue, manifest, velocity, freeze, admission, or sitemap state, and it is not part of authority:cycle.

r5_scan_exclusions.reason: Hostile-fixture self-tests contain protected-path strings on purpose, and write only into an isolated OS temp sandbox. Excluded files must be named selftest_*.mjs and must exist. The R5 scan is still proven live by the R5_lane_script_writes_publish_queue fixture, which uses a non-selftest filename.

grounded_search.call_shape: POST with plugins:[{id:web,max_results:N}]; the pages the answer was built from come back as message.annotations[].url_citation.url

previous_provider.reason: Google grounded search is hard-blocked on this project's key. Plain generateContent returns 200; the identical request carrying tools:[{google_search:{}}] returns 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, reproduced across three models and persistent. Its declared free_tier_daily_call_budget of 40 was therefore fiction: the real free allowance for grounded calls was zero, and this lane could never produce an observation. search-intelligence.yml has never completed a single run.

allowance.zero_incremental_cost_note: OpenRouter's web plugin bills per result returned, so this provider has NO free allowance and the declared free budget is 0 rather than an optimistic number. With no opt-in the lane spends nothing and makes no calls, and it reports NOT_RUN_NO_CALL_BUDGET rather than a green zero. Observations require SEARCH_INTELLIGENCE_ALLOW_PAID_SPEND=true and an explicit SEARCH_INTELLIGENCE_DAILY_CALL_BUDGET.

search_console.cost_note: Google Search Console API is free for the verified property owner.

repair_preparation.bounded_repair_rule: Emit the smallest bounded repair that the diagnosis evidence actually supports. Prefer improving one existing intent-matched route over proposing a new URL.

truth_boundaries: A grounded search observation is not a Google SERP rank.
A grounded search observation is not proof of indexation, ranking, or citation.
Preparing a repair candidate is not a publication.
A passing structural validator does not mean the providers were reachable.
Only Google Search Console may state own-site Google impressions, clicks, CTR, average position, or indexation.
Competitor observations describe what a grounded search response referenced. They are not competitor rankings.
